items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: But I told Walter Johnson - he was a drummer - you know, we always sat at a table together.

ctx.x: But didn't they catch up with it? They caught up with it financially, though, didn't they? Didn't you feel anything about that?

I was married to him and I was out having a good time. But I told Walter Johnson - he was a drummer - you know, we always sat at a table together. I used to tell them, these white people are not up here for no good. They stole every thing, but they thought it was cute for a white man to be up there listening to them play, you know, they thought it was cute. When you know anything, Benny Goodman stole everything.
You said that Harry James was up there, and Tommy Dorsey.
